{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales_df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for orders that are 'completed' AND have positive revenue
# This is the definition of a truly completed order
actual_completed_orders = sales_df[(sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & (sales_df['revenue'] > 0)]

# Count the number of such orders
count_actual_completed = actual_completed_orders.shape[0]

# Display the count
count_actual_completed"}
